description: Agent wallet with spending limits plus SOL escrow on Solana devnet (Anchor 0.31.1). initialize_platform_config, create_agent_wallet, transfer_with_limit, create_escrow, release_escrow and refund_escrow were verified with exact lamport payouts.
demonstrationNotice: Sol.College-owned demonstration of YouthAIAgent/agentwallet. The lab tree is branch sol-college-devnet of Blockchains/agentwallet-protocol (Blockchains/AgentWallet is an unrelated fork of a different project). The lab changed declare_id to a unique Sol.College devnet program and added a workspace Cargo.toml. The hosted IDL is hand-derived from the source because anchor idl build failed; discriminators were confirmed by live transactions. The upstream author has not joined Sol.College; acceptance here is by Sol.College, not by the upstream project.

scope: Anchor program correctness (agent wallet limits, platform fee, SOL escrow release and refund)
Frontend reliability of the hosted devnet console at sol.college/dapps/agentwallet/
QA: devnet proof of limit-checked transfers and escrow settlement
exclusions: Changes to the upstream repository other than ordinary pull requests
Security disclosure in public (security findings go to private channels)

assignments.title: Move transfer_with_limit funds into the agent_wallet PDA so limits guard custody, not just the signer's own SOL
